# Copilot Repository Instructions

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before making changes. It is the
canonical rule set for this repository.

For frontend work, also read
[`docs/FRONTEND_COMPONENTS.md`](../docs/FRONTEND_COMPONENTS.md): use the existing
shadcn `base-lyra`/Base UI components and semantic tokens, never restore legacy
CSS controls, and run React Doctor after substantial React changes.
